@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'local 192.168.1.42/24 dev lo scope host\n'
+            'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host\n'
+            'local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo scope host\n'
+            'local 192.168.1.0/24 dev lo scope host\n'
+            'broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev eth0 scope link\n', ''),
+        (0, 'local 2001:db8::2/64 dev lo scope host\n'
+            'local ::1 dev lo scope host\n', ''),
+    ]
+    result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+    assert result == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+        'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::/64'],
+    }
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_query_failure():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [(1, '', 'unsupported'), (0, '', '')]
+    assert LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip') == {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once()
